summary: C21 Investments Inc. filed a Form 6-K (management information circular) for a special meeting on August 7, 2026, to approve its acquisition by Vireo Growth Inc. via a court-approved plan of arrangement. Under the arrangement agreement dated June 14, 2026, Vireo will acquire all C21 shares at an exchange ratio of 0.023052 Vireo subordinate voting shares per C21 share. The C21 board unanimously recommends shareholders vote in favor. The transaction, structured as a Canadian plan of arrangement, requires court and shareholder approval. What to watch: shareholder vote outcome and regulatory approvals; the risk-arb spread depends on relative share prices.
